say:0:1611136001:0.text: So what if Merlin's on your side? I'm far more powerful than you think!
say:0:1611136001:0.source_cn: 即使梅林站在你们那边，又能把我怎么样？你们太小看我的力量了！
say:0:1611136001:0.male: So what if Merlin's on your side? I'm far more powerful than you think!
say:0:1611136001:0.female: So what if Merlin's on your side? I'm far more powerful than you think!

say:1:1611136002:0.text: Gervan, you still have time to make things right.
say:1:1611136002:0.source_cn: 格墨文，你现在回头还不算晚。
say:1:1611136002:0.male: Gervan, you still have time to make things right.
say:1:1611136002:0.female: Gervan, you still have time to make things right.

say:2:1611136003:0.text: Spare me the lecture. I'm done being the perfect student.
say:2:1611136003:0.source_cn: 省去那些说教的话，我已经厌烦当“模范学生”了。
